Subject: CAIQ mapping request and sampling — production scope

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our vendor assessment for Redwood Inference we need a CAIQ (CSA) mapping of your controls plus a small sample of artifacts for several high-priority areas (encryption at rest, key management, incident response, access provisioning). Our intake team attached a short scope doc outlining in-scope environments (production-only) — see Orchid_CSA_Scope.pdf.

Can you provide: 1) a control->artifact mapping for the CAIQ, 2) a short roster of control owners we can contact, and 3) example artifacts (screenshots / runbook excerpts / attestations) for ~10-15 priority controls? We aim to complete our initial review in 5 business days.

If you can confirm an owner and an expected delivery date by end of day tomorrow that would be great. Also propose a 30-min walkthrough for next week so we can walk the evidence together.

Thanks,
Paula Gomez

Orchid Bank
